label: Late-episode D2 a1->S1 ramp, boosted by prior reward and a1->S1 runs
terms: (phase == D2) * (action == 1) * (state == 1) * (ep_trial >= 90) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 1) * (state == 1) * np.clip(ep_trial - 90, 0, None) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 1) * (state == 1) * np.clip(ep_trial - 90, 0, None) * (prev_reward == 1) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 1) * (state == 1) * np.clip(ep_trial - 90, 0, None) * (tv("action", -1) == 1) * (tv("state", -1) == 1) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 1) * (state == 1) * np.clip(ep_trial - 90, 0, None) * (tv("action", -1) == 1) * (tv("state", -1) == 1) * (tv("action", -2) == 1) * (tv("state", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == D2) * (ep_trial >= 90) * (1 - (action == 1) * (state == 1))
explanation: Sparse feature (nonzero on 0.6% of steps), active only at D2 of the last ~10 trials of an episode (trial >= 90) when this trial's choice was a1 and it reached S1 (common). Both are observed at D2. Within that cell the magnitude ramps up roughly linearly with episode trial (slope ~0.03 per trial). The slope grows when the previous trial was rewarded (+0.07 per trial) and when the previous one or two trials were also a1->S1 (+0.035 and +0.02 per trial), so it builds over runs of rewarded a1->S1 and reaches ~1.6 near trial 97-99. The term for D2 cells in the last decile that are not a1->S1 (weight -0.11) corrects the timing baseline: the feature is ~0 at a1->S2, a2->S2 and a2->S1. It is ~0 at D1 and GO. Ideal-observer belief (belief_lo) adds nothing once these terms are in (dev 0.735 vs 0.735), so the observed-only fit loses nothing compared with the earlier value/policy-based label (low value late in the episode is captured by the episode-trial ramp). Additive tables reach only 0.06 ('all'), because the feature is a product of phase, choice/state, lateness and history. Test R^2 beyond timing 0.78 (dev 0.75).

issues: The original terms reproduce on test: R^2 beyond timing 0.7786 (timing alone 0.128). The fitted dev weights match the explanation: base slope +0.026 per trial, +0.071 after a rewarded previous trial, +0.035 when the previous trial was a1->S1, +0.022 when the two before were too, and -0.108 for the late-episode D2 cells that are not a1->S1.

Belief really does add nothing. Adding A*L*clip(belief_lo) to a refit of the same terms gives test 0.7460 vs 0.7456, with weight 0.001. So the claim that the observed-only explanation loses nothing holds.

Per-trial means at D2 for a1->S1 (relative to the decile baseline of 0.11) are about 0 up to trial 89. From trial 90 to 99 they are roughly 0.03, 0.06, 0.12, 0.21, 0.32, 0.45, 0.58, 0.74, 0.83, 0.77. The rise is convex up to trial 98 and flat or slightly down at 99, not 'roughly linear'. The step term of -0.146 makes up for this. The cell mean peaks near 0.8. Values of 1.3-1.7 occur only on long rewarded a1->S1 runs, so 'reaches about 1.6' describes the run peak, not the typical late cell.

a1->S2 (rare) at D2 is not exactly 0 late in the episode. It sits at about +0.03 to +0.12 absolute at trials 97-99, and the worst-fit windows show 0.24-0.32 at a1->S2 right after a1->S1 runs. This is small and was not captured. A term for 'a1->S2 times lateness times run length' got weight about 0.008 and no gain.

Systematic under-prediction remains on long consecutive rewarded a1->S1 runs. For example, in one worst-fit window the actual values were 1.36/1.51/1.61/1.68 against predictions of 0.35/0.63/0.89/1.05, and firing of 0.69-0.94 at trials 88-89 was predicted as 0. Window-limited fixes did not close the gap: a third back-trial in the run (test 0.747), reward counts (0.717), a1-only runs (0.749), state-only runs (0.769), quadratic ramps (0.766-0.774), and orig + a1 run + double reward (0.7794). It probably reflects build-up over history longer than the 3-trial context. It accounts for most of the remaining 22%.
Errors by phase x previous trial in misses are all below 0.006 in magnitude. Nothing systematic remains at D1 or GO, or by previous-trial pattern.

skeptic.better_terms: None of the alternatives beat the original by a meaningful margin. The best was the original plus A*L*a1(-1)*a1(-2)*a1(-3) and A*L*prev_reward*(reward(-2)==1), at test 0.7794 vs 0.7786.
